title: Greater New York 2026
description: More than 50 artists trace the layered realities, pressures, and possibilities shaping life across the New York region.
image_alt: Installation view of Greater New York 2026 at MoMA PS1

title: It's Alive! A Century of Animation
description: Production art and films by more than 35 artists reveal a century of New York animation before the digital turn.
image_alt: Animation artwork featured in It's Alive at MoMA
image_credit: Courtesy The Museum of Modern Art

title: Whitney Biennial 2026
description: Fifty-six artists, duos, and collectives consider kinship, ecology, technology, power, and unexpected ways of living together.
image_alt: Installation view of the Whitney Biennial 2026

title: Homeroom: Red Canary Song: Touch the Heart
description: A migrant massage- and sex-worker-led collective uses dining tables, portraits, and still lifes to hold stories of care, migration, and mutual aid.
image_alt: Red Canary Song installation at MoMA PS1
image_credit: Courtesy the artists and MoMA PS1

title: Frida and Diego: The Last Dream
description: Works by Frida Kahlo and Diego Rivera meet a theatrical installation developed alongside the Metropolitan Opera production.
image_alt: Artwork featured in Frida and Diego: The Last Dream
image_credit: Courtesy The Museum of Modern Art

title: Warm Up 2026
description: MoMA PS1's outdoor series brings underground and emerging dance music to the courtyard over six summer Fridays.
image_alt: Crowd at MoMA PS1's Warm Up music series

title: David Hockney: The Moon Room
description: Fifteen luminous iPad paintings follow the moon's changing phases from Hockney's farmhouse in Normandy.
image_alt: David Hockney Moon Room exhibition at Pace Gallery

title: Poppy DeltaDawn: The Trial of Socrates
description: Weaving, basketry, sculpture, and video ask who society decides is too dangerous to tolerate.
image_alt: Poppy DeltaDawn exhibition at Tiger Strikes Asteroid New York

title: Bryan Fernandez: En tránsito
description: Fernandez's first institutional solo exhibition follows movement, memory, and diasporic experience through layered mixed-media works.
image_alt: Installation view of Bryan Fernandez: En tránsito at ISCP

title: Julian Schnabel: Italy Through Its Trees
description: New paintings on maps and plate paintings turn Italy's umbrella pines into shifting structures of memory and abstraction.
image_alt: Julian Schnabel exhibition at Pace Gallery

title: Andy Warhol Family Album
description: Hundreds of Polaroids reveal Warhol's collaborators, friends, travel, domestic life, and compulsive approach to image-making.
image_alt: Andy Warhol Polaroid from Family Album

title: Mabel Dwight: Cool Head, Warm Heart
description: Lithographs of theaters, streets, and everyday rituals pair sharp social observation with an affectionate view of New Yorkers.
image_alt: Mabel Dwight lithograph featured at the Whitney Museum

title: Hyundai Terrace Commission: Kelly Akashi
description: Glass brick, steel, works on paper, and animation transform personal fire loss into a meditation on inheritance and rebuilding.
image_alt: Kelly Akashi installation on the Whitney terrace

title: Marcel Duchamp
description: The first North American Duchamp retrospective in more than 50 years spans painting, sculpture, film, photography, and printed matter.
image_alt: Marcel Duchamp artwork featured in the MoMA retrospective
image_credit: Courtesy The Museum of Modern Art

title: American Folk Art: Revisiting the Collection
description: Paintings, weathervanes, toys, and other objects revisit Abby Aldrich Rockefeller's role in bringing folk art into MoMA's history.
image_alt: American folk artwork featured at MoMA
image_credit: Courtesy The Museum of Modern Art

title: Esteban Cabeza de Baca: Ancestral Dreams
description: The annual plaza mural links Mesoamerican iconography, migrant labor histories, land protection, and speculative futures.
image_alt: Ancestral Dreams mural at MoMA PS1
